candidate_workaround: Use separate literal Select-String probes for each known phrase instead of passing a quote-heavy alternation through PowerShell.
failure_signature: A read-only ripgrep alternation returned two matches and then treated a shell-split fragment as a Windows filename, exiting nonzero.
recurrence_guard: On Windows, use one literal pattern per probe for quote-bearing code and never interpret partial results from a nonzero search as a complete audit.
rollback: Give the nonzero alternation zero complete-search credit, retain its partial matches, and rerun only bounded literal probes.
scope_boundary: Owner-local read-only search recovery only; no repository, sibling, scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Use literal separate probes for quote-bearing Windows searches
trigger_preconditions: A PowerShell search pattern contains alternation, embedded quotes, or shell-significant punctuation.
